verses.gurmukhi: ਅਜਯਾ ਅਧੀਨਤਾ ਤੇ ਪਰਮ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਭਈ ਗਰਬ ਕੈ ਸਿੰਘ ਦੇਹ ਮਹਾਂ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ajayaa adheenataa te param pavitr bhiee garab kai si(n)gh dheh mahaa(n) apavitr hai ||

en.bdb: A goat, herbivorous animal do good of yielding milk is considered pious and good because of its humble nature but a lion, proud and carnivorous is considered highly impious.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੋਨ ਬ੍ਰਤ ਗਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਊਖ ਮੈ ਪਯੂਖ ਰਸ ਬਾਂਸ ਬਕ ਬਾਨੀ ਕੈ ਸੁਗੰਧਤਾ ਨ ਸਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: mon brat gahai jaise uookh mai payookh ras baa(n)s bak baanee kai suga(n)dhataa na sitr hai ||

en.bdb: Because of his quiet nature, sugarcane has nectar-like juice in it, but noisy by nature bamboo cannot grasp any fragrance of sandalwood even if it grows close by.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੂਲ ਹੁਇ ਮਜੀਠ ਰੰਗ ਸੰਗਮ ਸੰਘਾਤੀ ਭਏ ਫੂਲ ਹੁਇ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਰੰਗ ਚੰਚਲ ਚਰਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: mool hui majeeTh ra(n)g sa(n)gam sa(n)ghaatee bhe fool hui kasu(n)bh ra(n)g cha(n)chal charitr hai ||

en.bdb: Rubiaceous plant (Majitha) has its colour characteristic in the bottom part of the plant but when joined with a cloth gives it a beautiful red colour and integrates with it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਅਸਾਧ ਸਾਧ ਦਾਦਰ ਅਉ ਮੀਨ ਗਤਿ ਗੁਪਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਮੋਹ ਦ੍ਰੋਹ ਕੈ ਬਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਹੈ ॥੧੩੨॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee asaadh saadh dhaadhar aau meen gat gupat pragaT moh dhroh kai bachitr hai ||132||

en.bdb: Similarly a willful or self-oriented person is like a frog whose love for water is fake and a deceit but a God-oriented person is like a fish whose love for water is strange and unique. (132)
